verdict.rationale: Gecko documents an official AI-tools/MCP integration. Once connected, a user's AI tool can list repositories and scans, pull vulnerability evidence, triage findings, and file tickets, so the product can be driven through natural language in an external assistant. There is no evidence of a natural-language command interface inside Gecko itself, and the language is interpreted by the third-party AI client rather than by Gecko. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of supported conversational commands or example prompts, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect it to an AI tool and the tool can list your repositories and scans, pull full vulnerability evidence (proof of concept, call chain, patch diff), triage findings, and file tickets.
